embed.title: !gym
embed.description: Alerts when a gym changes team. Optionally also when defenders join or leave, or when it is under attack.

fields.name: By team
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}gym d:1500` — any team
`{{prefix}}gym valor` — gyms taken by Valor
`{{prefix}}gym harmony` — gyms left empty
`{{prefix}}gym everything` — one rule for each team
One team per command. Teams: `valor`/`red`, `mystic`/`blue`, `instinct`/`yellow`, `harmony`/`gray`.

fields.name: More changes
fields.value:
`slot_changes` — also alert when defenders join or leave
{{#if userIsAdmin}}`battle_changes` — also alert when the gym is under attack (needs `[tracking] enable_gym_battle`)
{{else}}`battle_changes` — also alert when the gym is under attack, if your admin has enabled it
{{/if}}Example: `{{prefix}}gym mystic slot_changes`

fields.name: One gym
fields.value: `{{prefix}}gym "gym:Town Hall"` — only this gym, by name or gym id. Quote the whole option when the name has spaces. Needs scanner access, and your admin may limit who can use it.

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
With neither `d:` nor `area:`, your `{{prefix}}area` list is used (unless your admin set a default distance).
`d:1500` — within that many metres of your location
`location:home d:1500` — measured from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only these areas instead of your list; several: `area:north,south`. Can't be combined with `d:`

fields.name: Options
Remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}gym remove valor`
`{{prefix}}gym remove everything`
`{{prefix}}gym remove id:12` — one rule; `{{prefix}}tracked` shows the ids
